Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are therefore unknown. Do not claim clearance or a clean bill of health.

Do not admit the preview builds as public exposure: preview-only work may proceed only after capacity release, without credentials, DNS changes, new dependencies, data collection, or production publication, and with security unknowns preserved.
